title: SAC Planning-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title: Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Manager SAP SAC Planning / EPM Consultant to lead end‑to‑end planning implementations and drive finance transformation initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex, client‑facing EPM engagements, leveraging SAP SAC, BPC, and emerging AI capabilities such as SAP Joule.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**SAP SAC Planning – Implementation \& Delivery**
* A minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions.
* Lead end\-to\-end implementation of SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions, including requirement gathering, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and support.
* Design and build SAC Planning Models and Dimensions, including public and private dimensions with attributes and hierarchies.
* Develop Data Actions, Multi\-Actions, and Allocation processes to support driver\-based planning and automation.
* Configure planning workflows, version management, and data locking to enable governed planning cycles.
* Design and develop SAC Stories, Unified Stories, and Digital Boardrooms for executive and operational reporting.
* Build Optimized stories with advanced scripting to support complex planning and analysis use cases.
* Expertise in SAC security configuration.


**SAP Datasphere/HANA Modelling**
* Leverage 2–3 years of hands\-on SAP HANA Modelling experience or Datasphere and SAP BW experience in implementation.
* Design and develop SAP HANA Calculation Views to support SAC Planning and Reporting use cases.
* Perform data modelling, transformations, and performance optimization in SAP Datasphere.
* Collaborate with SAC planning teams to ensure optimal data structures and model performance.


**Soft Skills \& Competencies**
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey ideas in both technical and business friendly language
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills
* Highly process oriented with a structured approach to solution design
* Ability to work independently and lead complex engagements
* Strong documentation and knowledge sharing mindset


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience in BW
* Good understanding on SAP BDC, Datasphere Seamless planning and SAP Joule and AI.


**\<\< What we look for\>\>**
* Experience working on large scale finance transformation or planning initiatives
* Exposure to competitor EPM tools is a plus
* Ability to mentor junior consultants and contribute to capability building
* Expertise in delivering the process definition document post workshops. Preparing the system design document by mapping client requirements. Capable to work with the team on sprint planning for the delivery.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment** 
 : As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Biostatistical Programming Senior Associate (POPPK/PD)
description:
**Biostatistical Programming Senior Associate (** 
***POPPK/PD)***
**HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?**
 If you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever\-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.
   

  

**Biostatistical Programming Senior Associate**
**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.
   

  

 Amgen is expanding its global Statistical Programming capabilities, with Amgen India (AIN) playing a key role in supporting integrated delivery across regions. As a Biostatistical Programming Senior Associate, you will perform hands on statistical programming activities to support complex statistical data analysis of clinical studies and regulatory submissions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Analysis and reporting of clinical trial data using SAS and/or R
* Creation and validation of complex SDTM, ADaM, and other analysis datasets, both safety and efficacy
* Creation and validation of complex tables, listings, and figures, both safety and efficacy
* Prepare statistical programming specifications
* Prepare statistical programming related documents for regulatory submissions
* Maintain tracking and validation documentation
* Collaborate with cross\-functional team and create and/or validate complex programs for checking data quality
* Interact and collaborate with study team members from other functions globally
* Assist in some of the tasks of the Study Lead Programmer (SLP) or serve as a backup SLP


*For those assigned to the creation of Population PK and Population PK/PD datasets, key responsibilities may also include but not limited to:*
* Create input datasets (ADPPK/PopPK, ADPKPD/PopPKPD, and ERPK) for NONMEM® software to support Population PK and Population PK/PD analyses conducted by the Clinical Pharmacology Modelling and Simulation (CPMS) team.
* Create and review of PKPD and ERPK specification mappings.
* Serve as the backup Lead and support for at least one PopPK/PD project at a time.
* Manage individual programming assignments to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality datasets and outputs.


 This position will be located at Amgen India (Hyderabad).
   

  

**Win**
**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a results\-oriented, tech\-forward programming leader with deep expertise in clinical trial operations and digital transformation.
   

  

 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* BA/BSc or higher degree in biostatistics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or other related quantitative or scientific subjects, with at least 4 years of statistical programming experience in relevant career statistical programming experience in a clinical development environment.
* Familiarity with drug development life cycle and excellent skills with the manipulation, analysis and reporting of complex clinical trial data
* Ability to effectively perform complex statistical programming and related tasks
* Ability to provide quality output and deliverables in adherence with challenging timelines
* Ability to work effectively on multiple tasks or projects across therapeutic areas
* Ability to work effectively and successfully in a globally dispersed team environment with cross\-cultural partners
* Working knowledge of latest CDISC SDTM standards and familiar with CDISC ADaM and Define standards with strong ability to implement the standards
* In depth knowledge of SAS/STAT packages
* Familiar with data quality and compliance check tools
* Excellent oral and written English communication skills


*If assignment includes the creation of Population PK and Population PK/PD datasets:*
* Ability to lead small team projects effectively, willingness and ability to provide guidance to team members on technical and process questions
* Experience working with phase 1, 2, and 3 studies
* Familiarity with pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamics data


 Preferred Skills:
   

  

* MSc or higher degree in statistics, biostatistics, mathematics, or related quantitative or scientific subjects
* Familiarity with open\-source programming tools (R, Python), automation platforms, and emerging technologies in statistical programming
* Prior regulatory submission experience for drug approval


*If assignment includes the creation of Population PK and Population PK/PD datasets:*
* Experience developing specifications for other programmers
* Experience in understanding PK data workflow.


**Thrive**
**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, so we work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well\-being.
   

  

* Vast opportunities to learn and move up and across our global organization
* Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act

description:

 If you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission \-to serve patients \- drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together \- researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever\-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. *Let's do this. Let's change the world.*
 Amgen is expanding its global Data Science capabilities, with Amgen India (AIN) playing a key role in integrated delivery and functional leadership. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will independently lead complex analytical initiatives, designing and deploying advanced modeling, forecasting, and AI solutions that enable data\-driven decision making across Clinical Development. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong stakeholder engagement to deliver high\-quality, scalable analytics, influence strategic decisions, and help develop the capabilities of the broader Data Science team.

* Integrate and assess multi\-source clinical and operational data; define analysis\-ready data and quality checks.

* Develop robust code, reusable components and analytical pipelines using Python, R, SQL and approved cloud platforms.
* Translate results into practical scenarios, recommendations and decision support for study and portfolio teams.
* Guide Data Scientists and coordinate delivery with clinical, statistics, programming, digital and data\-platform partners.


**Accountabilities**

* Ensure methods, code, validation, documentation and communication meet reproducibility, compliance and governance expectations.
* Improve reusable modelling capabilities, standards and ways of working across the Data Science team.
* Identify and mitigate data, model, adoption and delivery risks; escalate material issues with clear options.


**End\-User Experience**
* Co\-design analytical products with CfDA, GBS, GDO and clinical stakeholders around priority decisions and user needs.
* Lead user testing, adoption feedback and iterative improvement of models and technology\-enabled products.
* Build trusted stakeholder relationships and communicate trade\-offs, assumptions and limitations early.


**Metrics**
* Timely delivery and adoption of validated analyses, models and documentation.
* Quality, reproducibility, reuse and maintainability of analytical solutions.
* Evidence that insights improve operational decisions and build team capability.


 This position is currently located at Amgen India (Hyderabad).

 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a strategic Data Science leader with a passion for tech\-enabled transformation.

* Master’s degree and 2 years of related experience, OR Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of related experience.


 Preferred Skills:
   

  

* Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Life Sciences or another quantitative field.
* Three or more years in clinical research, pharma, predictive analytics or a related applied setting.
* Advanced capability in Python and/or R plus SQL, reproducible workflows, version control, testing and cloud analytics.
* End\-to\-end experience developing, validating and operationalizing statistical, forecasting, ML or AI solutions.
* Experience leading analytical workstreams and coaching peers or junior colleagues.


**Thrive**
**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, so we work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well\-being.
   

  

* Vast opportunities to learn and develop within our global organization
* Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act
* Generous Total Rewards Plan comprising health, finance and wealth, work/life balance, and career benefits

title: Senior Analyst, US Customer Engagement Measurement & Insights
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

**Customer Engagement Measurement \& Analytics Delivery**
* Independently delivered measurement analyses assessing the effectiveness of omnichannel customer engagement across field, CRM, paid media, owned digital, and third\-party channels.
* Apply machine learning techniques to identify patterns in customer engagement, channel synergy, sequencing, pacing, and message performance.
* Support the development and operationalization of measurement frameworks, KPI tracking tools, and performance dashboards aligned with the team's strategic priorities.
* Synthesize analytical findings into clear, structured outputs and actionable recommendations for internal stakeholders and team leads.


**Experimentation \& Test\-and\-Learn Support**
* Support the design and execution of AI\-informed test\-and\-learn strategies, including A/B tests, lift studies, and incrementality experiments across customer engagement tactics.
* Assist in defining success metrics, measurement windows, and statistical approaches to evaluate new engagement strategies.
* Contribute to the documentation and socialization of experimental learnings to inform ongoing campaign planning across brands.
* Help refine experimentation frameworks to accelerate learning cycles and improve engagement effectiveness.


**Advanced Analytics \& Attribution**
* Apply advanced statistical and AI/ML techniques to measure the incremental impact of customer engagement activities.
* Support the use of attribution frameworks such as multi\-touch attribution, Markov chain modelling, and causal inference methods (e.g., propensity scoring, matched control).
* Contribute to the integration of outputs from MMx, KDA, and predictive models to support engagement optimization strategies.
* Leverage automation to improve speed, consistency, and repeatability of insights delivery.


**Stakeholder Partnership \& Communication**
* Partner with US Commercial stakeholders, Brand, Omnichannel Strategy, Field Analytics, CRM, Digital, and Technology teams to contribute to AI\-enabled measurement solution design.
* Clearly communicate measurement methodologies, assumptions, model limitations, and implications for decision\-making to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Contribute to stakeholder presentations and working sessions with structured, insight\-driven storytelling focused on impact and commercial actions.


**Team Collaboration \& Capability Building**
* Collaborate within cross\-functional and global teams to ensure consistent, scalable, and governed analytical delivery aligned with AI best practices.
* Mentor junior analysts on advanced measurement methodologies, analytical rigor, and responsible data usage.
* Contribute to the development of reusable analytics frameworks, measurement templates, and best practices that scale across brands.
* Promote high standards of reproducibility and documentation across all team deliverables.


**Technical Execution \& Data Stewardship**
* Build and maintain AI\-enabled measurement datasets, dashboards, and automated workflows supporting omnichannel engagement analytics.
* Work closely with data engineering, technology, and build teams to troubleshoot data issues and provide measurement\-driven feedback to enhance commercial solutions.
* Ensure analytical outputs are reproducible, well\-documented, and aligned with data governance, compliance, and responsible use standards.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex analytics and engagement insights into clear business outcomes, including AI\-generated findings.
* Solid project execution and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams in parallel.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail, data quality, and measurement rigor.
* Hands\-on expertise in applied statistics, analytics, and advanced measurement concepts relevant to omnichannel performance.
* Familiarity with HCP and patient engagement journeys across digital, field, and media channels.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed, stakeholder\-driven environment.
* Curiosity and passion for learning, innovation, and continuous improvement in analytics and measurement.


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* BA/BS required; advanced degree preferred in data science, analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, life sciences, computer science, or engineering.
* 3–5 years of professional experience in advanced analytics, decision science, or omnichannel engagement measurement roles, ideally within an AI\-driven commercial environment.
* Proven experience delivering end\-to\-end analytics and measurement projects, from problem framing to insight delivery.
* Experience with attribution and impact measurement techniques (e.g., multi\-touch attribution, causal inference, uplift modeling) is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with business stakeholders and support data\-informed decision\-making.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industries preferred.
* Proficiency in Python or R for analytical modeling and data transformation.
* Experience with cloud\-based analytics environments (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent) preferred.


 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models site\-essential, site\-by\-design, field\-based and remote\-by\-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https //careers.bms.com/ways\-of\-working.

 Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.

title: Sr Prin AI/Data Sci Engineer
description:

 The role requires deep expertise in Generative AI technologies and the ability to influence executive stakeholders, research teams, product organizations, and engineering functions to accelerate AI adoption while ensuring safety, compliance, explainability, and measurable business impact.

 As a Senior Principal Generative AI SME, you will:
   

  

* Partner with executive leadership, R\&D, product management, clinical experts, and software engineering organizations to define and execute enterprise Generative AI strategy.

* Mentor principal engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, and technical leaders while building organizational capability in Generative AI.
* Represent the organization in innovation councils, technical forums, conferences, research partnerships, and external collaborations.

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Enterprise AI Platform Leadership

+ Define enterprise architecture standards for AI deployment, observability, governance, security, and compliance.
+ Drive platform modernization using cloud\-native AI architectures.


* AI Governance \& Responsible AI
+ Ensure AI solutions comply with healthcare regulations and enterprise governance requirements.
+ Champion responsible AI principles including fairness, transparency, explainability, safety, traceability, and human oversight.
+ Establish model monitoring, risk management, and AI audit readiness processes.


* Technical Leadership
+ Serve as the highest\-level technical authority for Generative AI initiatives.
+ Conduct architecture reviews and technical assessments.
+ Mentor engineering and AI teams globally.
+ Influence technical direction across product portfolios and operating units.


**Required Knowledge And Experience**
* B.E/B.Tech/Master's or PhD in: Computer Science/Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning/Data Science/Computational Statistics/Applied Mathematics/Related quantitative discipline
* 15\+ years of software engineering, AI, machine learning, or data science experience.
* 8\+ years developing machine learning and AI systems.

**Company Description** 




  





 Coldbrew is a platform for building enterprise\-grade applications and AI agents using plain language, turning simple descriptions into working software. * Draft client\-ready valuation reports and memos including methodology rationale, model assumptions, sensitivity analyses, and concluded fair values; respond substantively to auditor and client review comments

title: Analyst II, Network Strategy and Performance
description:
**Description**
 As an Analyst within the Network Strategy Performance team, you will own analytics that directly shape where and how Amazon serves customers globally. You will model network scenarios spanning 100\+ sites across 40\+ countries, inform multi\-year investment decisions, and deliver insights that influence headcount allocation, site strategy, and contact routing for one of the world's largest customer service networks.
   

  

 This isn't a reporting role — you'll tackle ambiguous, high\-stakes questions: Where should we expand next? How do we balance cost\-to\-serve against customer experience across geographies? What's the optimal site mix for the next three years? Your analysis will flow directly into monthly, OP and 3YP cycles that leadership uses to allocate resources.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Operations, Products, FP\&A, and Service Delivery teams — identifying gaps, measuring performance, and driving automation and process improvement initiatives. You will contribute to the team's AI\-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own analytical inputs for network planning — model contact allocation scenarios, site investment options, and capacity strategies across geographies. Build and maintain the frameworks that determine how millions of weekly customer contacts are distributed across the global CS network, coordinating with Finance, and Service Delivery teams to ensure alignment with cost and CX targets.
* Translate complex or ambiguous network strategy questions into structured analysis — e.g., site expansion feasibility, cost\-to\-serve trade\-offs, regional performance variance. Dive into the heart of ambiguous problems with non\-defined inputs and outputs, identify root causes driving site or network\-level performance gaps, and derive recommendations that influence headcount allocation, site investment, and network architecture decisions.
* Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of planning outputs. Develop side\-of\-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.
* Design, implement, and support self\-service analytics platforms that provide business teams with ad\-hoc access to large datasets. Drive automation of data requirements by scaling data processes, creating dashboards, and building efficient queries across diverse data sources (contact volumes, productivity metrics, cost data, CX scores) to provide a holistic view of network performance.
* Communicate complex analytical insights and translate network performance data into clear narratives for Finance, Service delivery and senior leadership. Present analysis to leadership audiences with clarity and conviction. Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions (OP, 3YP, QXG), producing well\-structured documents that tie conclusions to business outcomes.


**About The Team**
 The Network Strategy and Performance (NSP) team defines and delivers the right human\-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1\) planning customer support staffing; (2\) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3\) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.
   

  

 We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, execution and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.
   

  

 The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future\-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive\-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking an L5 Labor Business Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* 2\+ years of supply chain experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

 CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose \- to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award\-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.
 



  





**About CIBC India:** 




 CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting\-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.
 



  





**What CIBC India Offers:** 




 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 



 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
 



 Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
 



 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (Position Summary):** 




 As a Senior Business Intelligence Consultant, you will lead the modernization of business reporting and analytics at CIBC, partnering closely with the Analytics Head Office in Toronto and key business stakeholders.
 



  





 This role sits within the business intelligence function and is focused on business reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and migration of business\-owned reporting assets and logic to modern cloud\-based environments. You will help transform legacy SAS/SQL reporting into scalable, business\-ready reporting solutions using SQL, Python, and Power BI or Tableau.
 



 In addition to the existing BI responsibilities, this role requires strong experience in Azure Databricks, experience in building data products, and practical use of AI in previous roles to improve reporting quality, productivity, or modernization outcomes.
 



 This is not a backend ETL pipeline engineering role or a source\-system data migration role. The primary focus is on management reporting, dashboard development, ad hoc analysis, reporting logic modernization, business insight delivery, and enabling modern BI capabilities through cloud\-based tools and data products.
 



  





 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed:** 



* Reporting \& BI Solution Leadership: Lead the modernization of legacy reporting assets and deliver business\-ready reporting solutions that support decision\-making.
* Own the development and enhancement of dashboards, scorecards, recurring management reports, and ad hoc analyses.
* Deliver reporting solutions that are accurate, scalable, user\-friendly, and aligned to business priorities.
* Business Partnership: Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, define KPIs and metrics, and translate business questions into actionable reporting solutions. • Act as a trusted advisor on reporting design, metric interpretation, and business insight delivery.
* Present findings, reporting logic, and recommendations clearly to business audiences with strong communication and confidence.
* Reporting Migration \& Modernization: Lead the migration of business reporting assets, SAS/SQL\-based reporting logic, and analytical workflows into modern cloud\-based reporting solutions. • Convert legacy reporting code and logic into SQL\- and Python\-based solutions that preserve business meaning and reporting integrity.
* Rationalize, simplify, and modernize legacy reports and reporting processes for improved usability and efficiency.
* Dashboarding \& Analytics: Develop advanced dashboards and business intelligence reports using Power BI or Tableau.
* Use SQL and Python for analysis, reporting logic, reconciliation, validation, and data preparation in support of reporting outcomes.
* Leverage Azure Databricks as part of the modern analytics ecosystem to support scalable BI and reporting use cases.
* Deliver ad hoc analysis and insight generation for business and leadership teams.
* Data Products: Contribute to the design, build, and evolution of data products that enable reusable, trusted, and business\-consumable data assets.
* Ensure data products are aligned with business outcomes, usability standards, and reporting requirements.
* Data Quality, Controls \& Governance: Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, complete, traceable, and aligned to governance standards and controls.
* Document business logic, metric definitions, assumptions, and key transformations as needed.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues that affect reporting integrity.
* Stakeholder \& Team Leadership: Build strong relationships with business partners, analytics teams, and related stakeholders across functions.
* Handle senior stakeholders effectively and demonstrate strong communication, executive presence, and confidence in discussions and presentations.
* Coach and support team members or junior analysts as appropriate, fostering strong reporting and analytical practices.
* Contribute thought leadership on BI/reporting modernization and business value delivery.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting activities and improve reporting workflows.
* Use AI or automation tools where appropriate to support code conversion, reporting quality checks, productivity gains, and insight generation.
* Recommend improvements to reports, dashboards, business processes, data products, and reporting operating models.



  





**Experience:** 



* 10\+ years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, MIS, or business\-facing data roles.
* Strong experience delivering management reporting, dashboards, ad hoc analysis, and KPI\-based reporting.
* Proven experience modernizing or migrating legacy reporting assets, including SAS/SQL\-based reporting logic.
* Strong track record of working directly with business stakeholders to define and deliver reporting solutions.
* Experience leading or significantly contributing to reporting transformation or reporting modernization initiatives.
* Strong experience in Azure Databricks as part of cloud\-based analytics or reporting environments.
* Experience handling stakeholders across business and technology teams with strong communication and confidence.
* Experience building data products that support reporting, analytics, or business decision making.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools or automation in previous roles for reporting migration, reporting quality assurance, analytics workflows, or productivity improvement.



  





**Who You Are:** 



* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Power BI or Tableau; one of these should be a core strength.
* Deep experience in business reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and stakeholder\-facing insight delivery.
* Strong understanding of KPI development, metric definition, reconciliation, and reporting controls.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical, high\-quality reporting solutions.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated leadership capability, including coaching, mentoring, or leading workstreams.
* Experience with SAS and legacy reporting environments is strongly preferred.
* Strong experience with Azure Databricks is required. • Experience building data products is highly valued.
* Familiarity with automation and AI\-enabled productivity tools is required, with practical prior usage preferred.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Exposure to Azure\-based analytics environments.
* Experience with Databricks in business intelligence and analytics use cases.
* Experience with business reporting migration into cloud\-based reporting platforms.
* Experience with both Power BI and Tableau.
* Financial services or regulated industry reporting experience.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile:** 



* Senior Business Intelligence consultant.
* Reporting and analytics lead.
* BI developer / BI analyst with strong business engagement.
* MIS / management reporting lead.
* Dashboard and KPI reporting specialist.
* Reporting modernization lead.
* Candidates whose experience is primarily in ETL pipeline development, data ingestion, backend data engineering, cloud infrastructure, or source\-to\-target migration without strong business intelligence and reporting delivery experience may be less aligned to this role.



  





**Privacy:** 




 By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Deloitte USI - Growth - Analyst | Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Deloitte USI – Growth – Analyst \| Hyderabad**
**About The Team**
 The Deloitte USI team works globally across practices and borders to support Deloitte’s Consulting business. The team is focused on offering our clients and people the global experience that’s essential in today’s world. Through the Deloitte USI team, we provide innovative solutions for cross\-cultural, cross\-border challenges our teams may encounter around the world. Leveraging leading\-edge tools, methods, and resources, we deliver top\-notch service that is applied locally while staying true to our global brand and core values.
   

  

 Within Global Consulting Services, the Growth team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and strategic insights across the industries , leveraging deep analytical expertise and a collaborative approach to drive client success and operational excellence in support of our Deloitte USI leadership and global network.
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 The professional will enable global leaders to make strategic decisions that translates into marketplace impact and growth. The professional will help accelerate execution of our Deloitte USI strategic agenda by delivering high impact strategic projects, simplifying and streamlining operations (reporting, PMO activities etc.), creating compelling and transparent leadership communications to solve the most complex challenges in exponentially powerful ways .
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
 The professional will work with the India colleagues across Deloitte USI practice. The professional will need to develop a knowledge of the firm’s Consulting Services business, strategic priorities to enable sharing of insights, trends and escalation of issues/variances as appropriate. They will analyse quantitative and qualitative data, synthesize outcomes, demonstrate strong analytical and business writing skills, and develop impactful narratives with recommendations based on research and analysis. The team’s projects are typically high\-impact and high\-visibility aligned to the global firm and Consulting Services leadership’s strategic priorities. Projects often involve collaboration across workstreams to ensure coordination and alignment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work on key strategic projects for Deloitte’s Deloitte USI business – Assist in development of hypotheses, identification of key business questions, conducting data driven analysis (quantitative and qualitative) to provide meaningful insights and actionable recommendations
* Assist in planning Global meetings and internal stakeholder engagements, supporting Global leadership to meet their objectives
* Partner with teams to drive global alignment around strategic priorities
* Demonstrate solid project management skills, and seamlessly support and switch to different workstreams as required
* Collaborate with multiple teams to standardize reporting processes and understand current/future reporting requirements
* Identify new tools and approaches to improve reporting, operational excellence, and insight generation
* Develop knowledge of the business and priority initiatives to share insights and trends as appropriate


**Requisite Core Skills**
* Self\-motivated, innovative, and strong team player
* Strong core consulting skills – i.e. research, financial analysis, business writing, problem\-solving, critical thinking, logical data structuring and knowledge in storyboarding techniques
* Write and edit Macros in Excel, create dashboards on Tableau, PowerBI, SharePoint knowledge and familiarity with online meeting platforms like MS Teams and Zoom
* Attention to detail, responsiveness, and track record of executing high\-impact initiatives
* Project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities given aggressive timelines
* Adaptable to fast paced, dynamic environments and working within teams, including virtual set\-ups
* Stakeholder management skills
* Highly developed personal and professional ethics are expected
* Must possess the ability to handle highest level of confidential information
* Experienced in collaborating effectively across team and career levels, including virtual team environment
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely


**Qualifications, experience, work location, and timing**
 We are looking for a passionate, high energy, and self\-motivated individual who is accustomed to working independently and collaboratively on small and large projects in a close\-knit team.
   

  

* Academic qualification: Master’s Degree like MBA
* Work experience: 2\+ years of relevant experience in Project Management, Business Intelligence, Market Research, Data Analysis or a related field
* Strong track record with previous employment, preferably with consulting firms or corporate strategy
* Location: Hyderabad
* Work hours: 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM (expected to be flexible with time zones)
* Working from office: The individual is expected to come to office at least 2 days a week as per the ‘work from office’ schedule


**About Deloitte**
 “Deloitte” is the brand under which independent firms throughout the world collaborate to provide services in a geographic area. These firms are members of Deloitte Touché Tohmatsu Limited DTTL, a UK private company limited by guarantee. With 260,000\+ people in over 150 countries, Deloitte member firms serve more than 80 percent of the world's largest companies as well as large national enterprises, public institutions, and successful fast\-growing companies
   

  

**Deloitte Support Services India Pvt.** 
**Ltd**
 Enabling Areas (EA) at the U.S. India offices are the support arm of the organization and comprise several groups including Talent, Technology, Finance, Communications, Field Operations, etc. EA gives every client\-service business unit access to the best and brightest resources when it comes to support services. More specifically, EA enables the business units to solely focus on satisfying clients and developing new products and services to sustain competitive advantage, while they consolidate and standardize a diverse collection of systems, processes, and functions. The team provides a wide array of services to the U.S and India professionals, and is continually evaluating and expanding its portfolio
   

  

**How You’ll Grow**
 At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team\-based learning, and eLearning. Deloitte University (DU): The Leadership Center in India, our state\-of\-the\- art, world\-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the DU in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits.
   

  

**Deloitte’s Culture**
 Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day.We offer well\-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives.
   

  

**Corporate Citizenship**
 Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill\-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities.
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Business Intelligence Associate - Talend and Snowflake
description:
Description for Internal Candidates Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 The Business Intelligence Engineer will be responsible for building data pipelines using their deep knowledge of Talend, SQL and Data Analysis on the bespoke Snowflake data warehouse for Business Intelligence.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 4 years of experience in Talend development, data integration, and data warehousing.
* Minimum 4 years of experience managing and supporting data warehouse environments in production.


**Talents Needed For Success**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Talend ETL/ELT solutions and data integration processes across CLAW applications.
* Develop and maintain data pipelines integrating multiple source systems into Snowflake and other target platforms.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Talend jobs, Snowflake processes, and data pipelines to ensure operational stability and performance.
* Manage production support activities, including incident resolution, change management, and problem management in accordance with ITIL processes and established SLAs.
* Collaborate within Agile/Scrum teams while following DTCC SDLC and release management practices.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, data mappings, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Support user onboarding, training, and knowledge transfer activities.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process improvements, and performance optimization across data integration and reporting solutions.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Talend ETL/ELT tools and data warehousing concepts.
* Advanced SQL development and query optimization skills.
* Experience with Snowflake and modern data warehousing architectures, including ELT/ETL methodologies.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, including Star and Snowflake schemas.
* Experience with source code repositories such as GitHub or Bitbucket.
* Experience implementing CI/CD deployment processes using Jenkins.
* Ability to analyze, tune, and optimize ETL jobs, data pipelines, and database queries for scalability and performance.
* Experience with data validation, testing, and reconciliation processes.


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of Windows and Unix/Linux operating environments.
* Experience with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Shell Scripting.
* Familiarity with JIRA and release management processes.
* Strong learning agility with the ability to quickly adopt new technologies and tools.


 Technologies
   

  

 Talend, Snowflake, SQL, Jenkins, GitHub, Bitbucket, JIRA, Python, PowerShell, Shell Scripting, Unix/Linux, Windows

title: Volunteer Academic Researcher to Join Small Global Team for Consults and Projects of Ashoka Fellows with Ashoka
description:
**This is an opportunity to work with an Ashoka Staff**
**This is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity**
**About The Affiliated Organization**
 Founded in 1980, Ashoka pioneered the field of social entrepreneurship. We are now the largest association of leading social entrepreneurs in the world, a network of 4000\+ Ashoka Fellows in 99 countries at work creating systemic change on the most pressing social and environmental issues of our time. We find, support and collaborate with our Fellows to help scale their solutions across nations and continents and work with a wide range of partners to create an "Everyone a Changemaker" world, one in which we all can find and develop our power to create meaningful change for the good of all.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.ashoka.org
   

  

**Job Description**
 Ashoka is looking for senior\-level professionals in specializing in academic qualitative and quantitative research who can provide our staff and Fellows with professional consults and project based engagement. These skillsets are highly valued by Ashoka Fellows, especially in academic fields in which they are working.
   

  

 We are creating an elite team of 10\-12 members from different world regions (to reflect cultural contexts and language) in this field and in nine others of similarly high\-value skillsets. We are calling these members Professional Support Partners (PSPs) rather than "volunteers" to reflect the expertise and commitment to impact you will bring to our global community.
   

  

 As an Ashoka Support Partner your expertise will be promoted to staff and Fellows over the course of two to three months. If there is a need that meets your interests and availability, an introduction will be made so that you can learn more details about the support partnership and ways that you can contribute. Until that time your name and contact details will be held confidentially to protect your privacy.
   

  

 Please let us know today if you'd like to join us!
   

  

**Volunteer Logistics**

 This position is Virtual (Remote)
   

  

**Language Requirements**
 English plus
   

  

**Desired Skills And Experience**
 Candidates should combine advanced methodological expertise with strong social\-entrepreneurship literacy, systems\-change evaluation experience, and the ability to translate complex evidence into actionable learning for diverse, globally distributed innovators.
   

  

**Core Qualifications And Experience**
* Advanced degree in a relevant field (e.g., Development Economics, Public Policy, Statistics, Social Sciences, Epidemiology, Data Science, or Health Economics); master’s preferred, with 6\-8 years of research experience.
* Mixed\-methods expertise: strong command of both quantitative (panel data, statistical inference, quasi\-experimental designs such as difference\-in\-differences, regression discontinuity, synthetic control, interrupted time series) and qualitative methods (case studies, theory of change validation, participatory approaches).
* Social\-impact and systems\-change evaluation: experience evaluating social entrepreneurship, nonprofit programs, or systems\-change initiatives; familiarity with proxy indicators, longitudinal tracking, and attribution challenges typical of early\-stage ventures.

**Ashoka\-specific competencies**

* Capacity strengthening: skill in coaching Fellows and local teams to design lean, credible measurement systems that fit early\-stage resource constraints while still producing decision\-useful evidence


**Soft Skills And Working Style**
* Analytical writing and storytelling: ability to synthesize complex findings into concise briefs, dashboards, and narratives for Fellows, partners, and institutional donors.
* Collaboration and empathy: comfort partnering with entrepreneurial leaders who may be measurement novices; ability to balance rigor with pragmatism and maintain a “do no harm” ethics stance in sensitive contexts.
* Learning orientation: commitment to embedding learning loops (not just reporting) so Fellows can iterate on strategy based on evidence.

title: Program Specialist III
description:
**About The Role**
 The Global Support Operations (GSO) Agent Experience (AX) team is responsible for ensuring Uber's customer support agents have the tools, technology, and workflows needed to deliver exceptional customer experiences. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Obsession (CO), GDX, regional Operations, and our global BPO partners to design, test, deploy, and continuously improve agent\-facing products across Uber's global support network.
   

  

 As a
 **GSO AX Program Specialist III** 
 , you will play a key role in shaping how new products and capabilities translate into effective frontline experiences. You will represent the voice of Operations and our support agents throughout the product lifecycle \- from identifying operational problems and defining business requirements, to validating solutions, leading pilots and Hawk tests, enabling global deployments across our BPO network, measuring impact, and driving continuous improvement.
   

  

 This role goes beyond supporting product launches. You will be expected to
 **own Agent Experience outcomes** 
 , influence cross\-functional product decisions, identify opportunities to improve how agents work, and build scalable approaches that enable Uber to deploy technology effectively across a complex, multi\-vendor global support ecosystem.
   

  

 As a Specialist III, you are expected to operate with a high degree of independence \- owning a portfolio of agent\-facing products or workstreams end to end, setting the approach rather than executing a defined one, and raising the bar for how GSO AX partners with Product and BPOs.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong operational judgment with product thinking, has lived the realities of a BPO/contact center environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and can influence stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, and our global BPO network.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Identify Agent Experience Opportunities \& Define Requirements**
* Partner with Operations, BPOs, Product, and other stakeholders to identify agent pain points, workflow gaps, and opportunities for technology\-enabled improvements.
* Run structured discovery \- agent shadowing, site visits, BPO listening sessions, tech error and UX issue intake \- to ground requirements in real frontline workflows.
* Translate operational needs into clear business requirements, use cases, and success criteria that Product and Engineering teams can act upon.
* Represent the voice of agents and Operations in product discussions and help ensure solutions are designed with frontline workflows in mind.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce agent effort and clicks, and improve the overall agent experience.


**Own Product Readiness, Incubation \& UAT**
* Own the operational readiness of new agent\-facing products and features, from early validation through global launch.
* Develop structured UAT, incubation, and pilot approaches that validate functionality against real\-world agent workflows and edge cases.
* Design and run pilots with BPO sites \- defining scope, agent cohorts, training, entry/exit criteria, and issue triage paths.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and BPO teams to identify issues, prioritize improvements, and determine readiness for broader deployment.
* Ensure learnings from pilots and testing translate into actionable product and operational improvements.


**Drive Product Efficacy \& Impact Measurement**
* Define success measures for new tools and capabilities in partnership with Product and Operations stakeholders.
* Lead Hawk testing and other efficacy assessments to understand how products perform in live operational environments, and own the Go/No\-Go recommendation for wider rollout.
* Evaluate the impact of tools on agent experience and operational outcomes across efficiency (AHT, agent effort), quality (QA score, defect/rework rates), customer experience (CSAT, FCR), and adoption/utilization.
* For AI\-enabled capabilities, measure containment/deflection, suggestion acceptance, answer quality, and escalation impact \- and flag quality or trust risks early.
* Build and maintain your own reporting \- pull and analyze data directly (Google Sheets, SQL, Tableau/Looker, or AI\-assisted analysis) rather than depending on analyst support for routine questions.
* Synthesize quantitative and qualitative insights to support product decisions and go/no\-go recommendations.


**Build the Product\-Operations Feedback Loop**
* Establish strong feedback mechanisms between frontline Operations, BPO partners, GDX, and Product teams.
* Aggregate and prioritize agent and operational feedback to identify recurring product opportunities and systemic issues.
* Convert frontline insights into structured recommendations that influence product roadmaps and future iterations.
* Close the loop with Operations and BPO partners by communicating how feedback has translated into product changes or decisions.


**Influence Through POD \& Cross\-Functional Engagement**
* Represent GSO Agent Experience in PODs and other cross\-functional forums.
* Build trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Customer Obsession, GDX, regional Operations, and BPO stakeholders.
* Advocate for agent needs while balancing product, technical, operational, and business considerations.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders when ownership or solutions span multiple teams, and escalate crisply when decisions stall.


**Enable Global Deployment \& Adoption**
* Partner with regional and BPO stakeholders to develop scalable deployment and adoption strategies for new capabilities across sites, vendors, languages, and lines of business.
* Work with BPO training, quality, and WFM teams to land enablement \- training materials, knowledge updates, floor support, and change communications.
* Monitor adoption and product health across markets and identify barriers to successful utilization.
* Diagnose differences in adoption or performance across regions, vendors, and sites, and develop targeted interventions.
* Capture learnings from deployments and use them to continuously improve future launch approaches.


**Advance AI\-First Agent Experience**
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve agent workflows and the way GSO manages product deployments.
* Support the rollout and evaluation of AI\-enabled support capabilities \- agent assist and copilots, automated summarization, AI\-driven knowledge retrieval, AI QA, and customer\-facing automation \- including how they change the agent's role and required skills.
* Harness AI to develop dashboards, webpages, launch trackers, playbooks, and knowledge assets that improve visibility into product health, launch readiness, and operational performance.
* Translate complex technical and product developments into clear narratives and actionable guidance for Operations and leadership.
* Champion AI\-first ways of working by automating documentation, reporting, analysis, and knowledge management where appropriate.
* Contribute to shaping the future of AI\-enabled customer support and Uber's Agent of the Future .


**What You'll Need**
**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Operations, Operations, Program Management, Customer Support Operations, UAT, or a related field.
* Direct BPO experience: Working within, operations, managing teams, or partnering with outsourced BPO/contact center operations. This includes hands\-on exposure to frontline agent workflows and day\-to\-day site realities (staffing, training, quality, floor support, adherence).
* Demonstrated experience working with external BPO vendors and site leadership to land change: running pilots or UAT with BPO agents, driving tool adoption across multiple sites or vendors, and managing performance conversations grounded in operational data.
* Experience working within customer support, contact center, or other large\-scale operational environments, and familiarity with core support metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, QA score, occupancy, adoption/utilization).
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, and drive solutions across multiple stakeholders with minimal direction.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to combine operational data and qualitative insights into clear recommendations; comfortable working in spreadsheets and dashboards independently.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and operational audiences, and to present recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple initiatives and stakeholders simultaneously in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional, multi\-timezone environment.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive initiatives from problem identification through implementation and measurement.
* Working knowledge of AI\-enabled customer support tools, agent\-assist technologies, and emerging applications of AI in Operations, with practical use of AI tools in your own workflow.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting or owning technology/product launches within customer operations at global scale.
* Experience operating in a multi\-vendor BPO model \- coordinating across several outsourcing partners, sites, and geographies with differing maturity levels.
* Familiarity with BPO commercial and governance constructs (SOWs, SLAs, QBRs, capacity and ramp planning) and how tooling changes affect them.
* Experience translating operational problems into business or product requirements (PRDs, BRDs, user stories).
* Familiarity with UAT methodologies, incubation, experimentation, pilot programs, A/B or holdout testing, and product efficacy measurement.
* Experience partnering directly with Product, Engineering, Design, or Technical Program Management teams.
* Experience evaluating AI/GenAI support capabilities in production \- measuring answer quality, deflection/containment, and agent trust and adoption.
* Experience using data to evaluate product adoption and operational impact; hands\-on with SQL, Tableau, Looker, Google Sheets, or similar.
* Experience developing scalable processes, frameworks, or operating models across multiple markets or teams.
* Experience with knowledge management, agent enablement, or support content operations.
* Demonstrated interest in AI, automation, and the future of customer support.


**Ready to Ride?**
 This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
   

  

 Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
   

  

 Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.
