title: Bioinformatician
description:
Manna Biotech is looking for a skilled and research\-oriented Bioinformatician who can independently handle bioinformatics projects, analyse biological datasets, support research and academic projects, and train students in practical bioinformatics workflows.
   

 The candidate will work closely with the research and academic teams and will be responsible for taking assigned projects from problem definition and data collection through analysis, interpretation, visualization and report preparation.
   

 Key Responsibilities
   

 1\. Bioinformatics Research \& Data Analysis
   

 Perform bioinformatics analysis for academic, research and client projects.
   

 Analyse genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic and other biological datasets.
   

 Retrieve and curate biological data from appropriate public databases.
   

 Perform sequence retrieval, alignment, annotation and comparative sequence analysis.
   

 Conduct phylogenetic and evolutionary analyses.
   

 Perform gene/protein functional annotation and enrichment analysis.
   

 Perform pathway and network\-based analysis where required.
   

 Interpret computational results from a biological perspective.
   

 Prepare publication\-quality tables, figures, heatmaps, plots and other visualizations.
   

 2\. NGS \& Omics Analysis
   

 The candidate should be able to work with or develop proficiency in:
   

 Raw sequencing data QC and preprocessing
   

 FASTQ/FASTA handling
   

 Read trimming and filtering
   

 Genome/transcriptome alignment
   

 Variant analysis
   

 RNA\-Seq and differential gene\-expression analysis
   

 Functional enrichment analysis
   

 GO and KEGG/pathway analysis
   

 Microbiome/16S analysis
   

 Metagenomics workflows
   

 Whole\-genome/exome analysis
   

 Oxford Nanopore sequencing data analysis
   

 Integration and interpretation of multi\-omics datasets
   

 3\. Computational Biology \& Drug Discovery
   

 Depending upon project requirements, responsibilities may include:
   

 Protein and nucleotide sequence analysis
   

 Protein structure retrieval and analysis
   

 Homology modelling
   

 Molecular docking
   

 Virtual screening
   

 Molecular dynamics\-related workflow support
   

 ADMET and drug\-likeness analysis
   

 Target identification and validation
   

 Protein–protein interaction analysis
   

 Network pharmacology
   

 Biomarker discovery
   

 4\. Programming \& Data Science
   

 Working knowledge of one or more of the following is preferred:
   

 Python \| R \| Linux/Unix \| Bash \| Bioconductor
   

 The candidate should be comfortable handling large biological datasets and should progressively contribute to:
   

 Workflow automation
   

 Reproducible analysis pipelines
   

 Statistical analysis
   

 Biological data visualization
   

 Machine learning/AI applications in bioinformatics
   

 Documentation of scripts and computational workflows
   

 5\. Student Training \& Mentoring
   

 An important component of this position is training and academic mentoring.
   

 The Bioinformatician will:
   

 Train BSc, MSc, BTech, MTech, BPharm, MPharm, PharmD and other life\-science students.
   

 Conduct practical bioinformatics training sessions.
   

 Mentor internship students.
   

 Guide dissertation and project students.
   

 Help students understand the biological rationale behind computational analyses.
   

 Design project topics based on the student's academic background and interests.
   

 Develop practical exercises, datasets and training materials.
   

 Monitor student project progress and maintain appropriate records.
   

 Assist students in interpreting results and preparing project reports/presentations.
   

 6\. Research Project Development
   

 The candidate should assist the Manna Biotech research team in:
   

 Literature review
   

 Identification of research gaps
   

 Development of research questions
   

 Designing bioinformatics methodologies
   

 Selection of databases, tools and analytical pipelines
   

 Development of innovative research/project concepts
   

 Integration of wet\-lab and computational findings
   

 Preparation of research reports and manuscripts
   

 Preparation of scientific figures and supplementary data
   

 7\. Client Project Management
   

 For assigned client projects, the Bioinformatician will be expected to:
   

 Understand the scientific objective and deliverables.
   

 Assess data and analysis requirements.
   

 Prepare an appropriate computational workflow.
   

 Execute analyses accurately and within agreed timelines.
   

 Maintain organized project files and analysis records.
   

 Perform appropriate quality checks before submission.
   

 Explain results to the research/project coordination team.
   

 Assist in technical discussions with clients when required.
   

 Confidentiality of client data and unpublished research is mandatory.
   

 Technical Skills Preferred
   

 Experience with several of the following would be advantageous:
   

 NCBI, BLAST, UniProt, PDB, Ensembl, UCSC Genome Browser, GEO, SRA, Galaxy, Clustal Omega, MEGA, Cytoscape, STRING, DAVID, KEGG, R/Bioconductor, Python, Linux, AutoDock/AutoDock Vina and relevant genomics/NGS analysis tools.
   

 Knowledge of emerging AI/ML applications in genomics, precision medicine, biomarker discovery and computational drug discovery will be considered an advantage.
   

 Documentation Responsibilities
   

 The candidate must maintain proper documentation for:
   

 Projects undertaken
   

 Analysis pipelines
   

 Input and output datasets
   

 Software/tools and versions used
   

 Parameters used for analyses
   

 Results and interpretations
   

 Student training activities
   

 Project progress
   

 Final deliverables
   

 Analyses should be traceable, scientifically defensible and reproducible wherever technically feasible.
   

 Educational Qualification
   

 Preferred: MSc/MTech or equivalent qualification in:
   

 Bioinformatics
   

 Computational Biology
   

 Biotechnology
   

 Genomics
   

 Systems Biology
   

 Life Sciences with strong bioinformatics experience
   

 Candidates with relevant project/research experience will be preferred.
   

 Candidate Profile
   

 The ideal candidate should have:
   

 Strong understanding of molecular biology and genetics.
   

 Good analytical and problem\-solving ability.
   

 Ability to learn new bioinformatics tools rapidly.
   

 Research\-oriented thinking.
   

 Ability to independently execute assigned analyses.
   

 Good scientific communication skills.
   

 Ability to teach and mentor students.
   

 Good documentation and presentation skills.
   

 Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
   

 Professional approach toward confidential research/client data.
   

 Key Performance Expectations
   

 Performance will primarily be assessed on:
   

 Scientific Accuracy \| Project Completion \| Turnaround Time \| Data Quality \| Documentation \| Student Training Quality \| Client Deliverables \| Research Contribution \| Workflow Development \| Professional Conduct
   

 Reporting
   

 The Bioinformatician will work under the Research/Academic Management of Manna Biotech Private Limited and coordinate with laboratory, research, training and project\-management teams as required.

title: Tech Lead – Agentic AI Platform
description:
**About Multiscale AI** 




 Multiscale AI builds agentic AI systems for semiconductor manufacturing. Our platform combines domain retrieval, automated analytical workflows and agent orchestration to help fab engineers move faster on complex data problems. Offices in Atlanta, San Francisco and Hyderabad.
 



  





**The Role** 




 SMPO AI is our agentic orchestration platform: a chat\-driven system that plans and executes AI agent work in isolated compute environments and streams results back to the user in real time. As Tech Lead you will own the technical health of this platform end to end, act as Architecture Owner for the team, and be the single technical reporting point for our Hyderabad product engineers.
 



 This is a hybrid role: roughly two\-thirds hands\-on system design and code, one\-third technical leadership.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* Platform architecture end to end: how a user request becomes an agent run, how execution is orchestrated, and how results stream back in real time.
* Reliability for long\-running agents in disposable environments: recover cleanly from failures without losing or duplicating work; checkpointing and durable agent state.
* The lifecycle and security model of the sandboxed compute environments agents execute in.
* The security and audit model for agents: role\-based access control, authentication passthrough and impersonation, immutable audit trails, identity and provisioning flows that customer security teams will review.
* LLM and tool gateways: MCP servers, tool registration and credential management, so every agent action goes through a controlled, logged interface.
* The retrieval layer: embeddings, vector stores and enterprise document access tuned for fab and materials\-science data.
* Observability: tracing, monitoring and the evidence that agents behaved as intended.
* Evaluation as a release gate: no AI\-driven feature ships without an eval suite that proves it against known cases.
* Support for network\-isolated and air\-gapped customer deployments.
* Performance and scale targets: concurrency, run duration, startup latency.



  





**Technical Leadership** 



* Architecture Owner: final reviewer on changes that affect platform architecture, including AI\-authored ones.
* Lead the Hyderabad product team: single point of technical reporting, owning workload planning and balance in coordination with the US product lead.
* Drive spec\-first development; set the quality bar for AI\-driven features; mentor engineers on agentic system design and on using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) safely.
* Partner with DevOps on CI/CD: release\-candidate promotion, ArgoCD GitOps deployment and production quality gates.
* Own hiring for the India product team: rubrics, technical screening and shortlists.



  





**What We Are Looking For — Required** 



* 5\+ years of software engineering, including 2\+ years in a technical\-leadership or architecture\-ownership capacity.
* Strong backend engineering in Python; production services on databases and caching/queueing infrastructure (MongoDB and Redis a plus).
* Solid distributed\-systems fundamentals: coordination, failure detection, idempotent operations.
* Experience building or operating systems that run workloads in containerised or ephemeral compute.
* Practical experience building LLM\-powered or agentic systems: multi\-step execution, streaming output, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals (LangGraph or comparable).
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise security patterns for AI systems: RBAC, authentication passthrough, audit logging; SOC 2 exposure a plus.
* Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool\-calling interfaces for agents.
* Experience defining and running eval suites for LLM\-driven features and using them as release gates.
* Working knowledge of RAG pipelines end to end: embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and where they fail.
* Experience with observability for distributed or agentic systems: tracing, monitoring, alerting.
* Experience leading a small engineering team day to day: planning, prioritisation, workload balance.
* Comfort with event\-driven architectures; a track record of owning architecture decisions and reviewing others’ designs at a senior level.



  





**Preferred** 



* AI\-assisted engineering workflows at team level (Claude Code, Cursor): project configuration, shared prompt libraries, spec\-driven development.
* GitOps deployment (ArgoCD) and progressive delivery (canary / blue\-green).
* Network\-isolated or air\-gapped deployment environments.
* Domain exposure to semiconductor manufacturing, industrial analytics or other data\-heavy enterprise verticals.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Real ownership from day one of a platform already in production for a Fortune\-500 manufacturer.
* Small team, fast decisions, direct access to customers and their hardest problems.
* Competitive compensation.
